scaling: s = min(W/1920, H/1080). For anchor (ax, ay): screen = (ax*W, ay*H) + (ref - (ax*1920, ay*1080)) * s. Sizes, radii, strokes and text sizes multiply by s. Anchor 'stretch' maps the reference frame to the whole window.

fonts.outline_limit: a shadow's grow must stay under 12 * size / 64 - 1 px (the distance field ends there)

font.about: fallback for today's code (two faces of one atlas); Juice elements name a face from fonts

key_cap.about: flow item {type: key, text, size, face, color}: the key name drawn in a cap made from these numbers (fill, ink border, ink drop), then the next item; the cap is never narrower than tall

damage_tip.about: sticker damage_tip caps SCREEN's damage arc: drawn at 50 % of its cell (42 x 33 px at 1080), its centre on the arc's middle at radius marks.damage.gap_px + 16, rotated so the tip points away from the screen centre; its ink rim is then 4 px, so draw the arc as a 14 px damage_mark band with a 4 px ink rim each side (22 px of ink under it)

buy_stats.about: the three bars on a weapon card, 0..1, from design_numbers.json weapons (sidearm, smg, rifle, sniper)
buy_stats.damage: body damage of the first range band / the largest such value among the four
buy_stats.rate: shots_per_second / the largest among the four
buy_stats.range: (1 / (1 + 4 * a)) where a = the smallest of spread_deg.stand and spread_deg.scoped_stand; then divided by the largest among the four

buy_rewards: buy.reward_win = economy.round_win; buy.reward_loss = economy.round_loss_by_streak[the team's current loss streak, capped]
team_strip: team.N.can_rifle = that teammate's credits >= weapons.rifle.cost (credits shown in juice yellow)
kinds:
(all are rounded-rect quads, glyph quads or icon quads):
  plate  rounded rect: fill, radius, optional stroke {width, color}: an SDF border band inside the
         plate starting stroke_rim px in from the edge, over the fill, so a dark rim frames it on
         light scenes
  text   glyph run from font_atlas.json: text (template, see below), size, weight (= face: regular,
         bold), align, color; baseline = rect.y + rect.h / 2 + cap_height * size / em_px / 2
  icon   icon atlas quad, fitted (contain) and centred in rect, tinted by color; fit "trim" fits the
         icon's drawn part (icons_atlas.json "trim") instead of its whole cell
  bar    track plate + fill plate; fill length = value/max along dir (ltr, rtl, btt); optional "knob"
         {size, fill, ring}: a disc centred on the end of the fill (sliders)
  pips   count small rounded rects aligned in rect (align: center or left); the first `value` use `on`, the rest `off`;
         when value >= count and `full` is set every pip uses `full`
  image  a texture quad (file named by "image", a template, e.g. minimap.png), fitted in rect ("fit":
         "contain" (default) or "cover": fills rect, cropping the overflow equally on both sides; "image_small"
         is the same picture at 1280 x 720 for windows up to 720 px tall),
         tinted by color; with "atlas" (e.g. portraits.json) and "key" (template) it shows that atlas cell
  markers one atlas icon per item of the list at data path "items": each item has pos (map metres),
         optional yaw (compass degrees, rotates the quad about its centre when "rotate" is true) and
         optional color (palette key, else the element's color); positions go through the map's json
         ("map", e.g. minimap.json: map_to_px) into rect; "outline" draws "outline_icon" (a grown copy
         of the icon, same quad) in that colour first; "backing" draws a disc of that fill under the icon
  flow   one plate that fits its content, aligned in rect (left, center, right); items laid left to right with gap
         (text width = chars * 0.6 * size for the monospace font, icons use their w)

Shared fields: id, kind, rect [x, y, w, h], anchor, when, style_if.
  unscaled  true keeps reference pixels at every window size (crosshair): only the anchor moves
  text sizes never go below font.min_px after scaling
  when      a data path that must be truthy; a leading "!" negates
  style_if  [{"when": path, "set": {field: value}}] applied in order before drawing
  colors    a palette key, or "@path" whose value is a palette key
  templates "{path}" or "{path|format}"; formats: int, clock (seconds -> m:ss), credits (1,234),
            sec1 (one decimal + s), upper
  text.face        one of "fonts" (display, display_bold, text, text_bold); "weight" stays as today's fallback
  icon.atlas       "stickers": the full-colour sticker atlas (stickers.json), drawn untinted (no color)
  arc              ring sweep: rect (square), value, max, width, color, track, start_deg (0 = 12 o'clock), clockwise
  shadows          also on flow, bar, pips, icon (today: plate and text)
  when             a list = all must hold; "path=value" compares a text value
  images           sticker pictures select_<fruit>.png from this kit replace the old ones (same names)

tips: Walking is silent. Running is heard 28 m away.
Past halfway, a defuse keeps its progress.
A plant pays the whole team 300 credits.
